tools.name: search_ads
tools.description: Searches the Ad Radar library of Facebook and Instagram ads from the Meta Ad Library (every ad has at least $50k estimated spend), with the same filters as the Ad Radar board. By default it returns only active ads, sorted by score, as compact rows. Each row has an adKey, which get_ad and get_swipe_p

tools.name: get_ad
tools.description: Returns the full record of one ad: headline, body, CTA, full transcript, metrics, spendEstimate (an ESTIMATE based on engagement, not real spend; spendLowerBound = it is a minimum, "at least"), delivery status, winnerObservation (when we first observed it above $50k), media (public URLs), links (pos

tools.name: get_swipe_prompt
tools.description: Returns a prompt template built from one ad, written for the user to run on their own product. The result is JSON with the template text in the template field. kind='swipe' is a template that maps the ad's beats, checks the fit with the user's product, drafts a full version with the same structure a

tools.name: list_taxonomy
tools.description: Lists the taxonomy dimensions of the Ad Radar library (awareness, angle, hook_pattern, vformat, pformat, landing...) with their valid values. These slugs are the values the tags filter of search_ads accepts.

tools.name: advertiser_hooks
tools.description: Returns the hooks, hook mechanisms and angles an advertiser uses most, counted over all of its ads in the library. advertiserId is the advertiser id shown in search_ads rows.

tools.name: winning_patterns
tools.description: Returns, for each taxonomy value, how many times more often it appears among winning ads than on average (lift), with adoption (ads, advertisers) and example ads; the same data as the 'What to do now' block of the Ad Radar analytics page. doThis lists the values above average, lower the values below

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_ad · Private data: get_ad · Public sink: get_ad · Destructive: get_swipe_prompt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_ad · Private data: get_ad · Public sink: get_ad · Destructive: get_swipe_prompt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
